description: Under the Jordanian penal code of 1960 applicable in the West Bank, a man who surprised his wife or a female relative committing adultery and killed or harmed her was entitled to a 'pardoning excuse'. Only men could benefit; a woman in the same circumstances could not invoke it.
energy_note: An excuse in the statute book, for killing her.

aspect: It was repealed, and the sentences still fall
description: A 2011 presidential decree annulled Article 340 in the West Bank and amended Article 18 of the 1936 Mandate code in Gaza. But Articles 97, 98 and 99 still permit reduced punishments, and in Gaza courts often give reduced sentences on honour grounds despite no legal basis for doing so.
energy_note: The excuse was deleted. The discount remained.

aspect: EXAMPLE - the Nablus sentence, four times over
description: A first instance court used articles 97 and 98 to reduce the sentence to two and a half years. On appeal he was convicted of premeditated murder and sentenced to 25 years. Article 99 and time served cut that to 10. The cassation court then reduced the charge again.
energy_note: Twenty-five years, then ten, then less.

aspect: The label is used to hide other motives
description: Women Media and Development (TAM) reported that killings actually motivated by inheritance or revenge were framed as honour crimes so the killer would receive a lighter sentence. The discount creates an incentive to claim it.
energy_note: Call it honour and the sentence halves.

description: WCLAC documented 23 killings of Palestinian women and girls in 2016 across the Palestinian territory, many claimed to be honour-based.
energy_note: Twenty-three, in one year, in a small population.

description: The 'marry-your-rapist' provision, which extinguished prosecution if the perpetrator married the victim, was repealed in 2018.

aspect: Impunity is social before it is legal
description: Lawyers working on these cases argue the impunity is not encoded simply in the letter of the law - the culture has historically been more tolerant when the killing is justified by honour, and that is what the judges are drawn from.
energy_note: The statute is only half of it.

aspect: What it means day to day for a woman who is not in danger
description: The existence of a reduced-sentence route changes the calculation behind every argument about where she goes, who she speaks to, and what she wears - not because anyone threatens her, but because the discount is known to exist.
energy_note: A background pressure that never has to be stated.
